description: Prices and market state on Hyperliquid right now: perp mark and oracle price, 24h move, funding (hourly and annualised), open interest, volume and max leverage, plus spot pair prices. Pass a symbol for one market with predicted funding on Hyperliquid, Binance and Bybit side by side. This is the current snapshot; for how funding behaved over past days use hl_funding. Read-only, public data, no API key.

market.description: Which book to read. Default perp.

symbol.description: Market symbol, e.g. BTC or PURR. Omitted = top by volume.

title: Hyperliquid markets
